searchPolicy: No pause or discarded warmup query before the first search. One embedding API call warms the configured backend before launching the measured app, as required by the published warm-backend protocol. Every app semantic-backend and semantic-search sample is retained.
boundaryPolicy: Read-only SQLite counts and long-note hashes before/after the startup series, each startup launch, each editor run, graph session and search session. In-app semantic status and note hashes before/after each interactive session. Auto-exiting startup has no in-app status channel.
longNotePolicy: Typing is permitted to change the note. A stopped after-boundary rejects any non-editor session that changed the long note.
profileIsolation: Fedora isolated XDG roots. Windows config and window-state copied and hashed; logs, EBWebView and the new vault state junctioned into the disposable directory, then restored.
controllerNote: Monitoring coordinator restarted once to cast PowerShell Get-Content values to plain strings before JSON serialization. Apps, index warmup and measured rows were not restarted.
baselineRam: No matching post-search RAM snapshot exists in the main 46134c3 performance row; new snapshots are retained for a later comparison.
